title: Archive-coupled deflated Gauss-Newton for distinct-root recovery
objective: Determine whether a small fair lane of good deflated Gauss-Newton steps, driven only by canonically validated configuration witnesses, increases fixed-budget recovery of distinct target values without replacing the current full-support multistart and canonical verification paths.
hypothesis: Once one isolated regular configuration has been validated, shifted configuration-space deflation can redirect otherwise duplicate local convergence toward nearby isolated roots; a nonvanishing ordinary LM-QR lane and undeformed canonical endpoint replay will preserve generality and safety when the deflation assumptions fail.

included: bounded smooth square and overdetermined nonlinear least-squares systems
canonically validated provisional configuration witnesses used only as reversible search hypotheses
good deflated Gauss-Newton step scaling and shifted residual-deflation controls
fixed attempt and primal-equivalent oracle-work prefix comparisons
close isolated roots, target collisions, nonzero minima and open-world branch/domain controls
excluded: irreversible output deduplication from floating configuration distance
deflating target values instead of configuration witnesses
whole-system polynomial lowering or symbolic deflation
product connection before an untouched family-disjoint locked gate

literature.claim: Shifted residual deflation prevents Newton-like iteration from reconverging to an already known isolated solution while recovering the original residual far from deflated points.
literature.assumptions: Known solutions are isolated and the nonlinear iteration, norm, power and nonzero shift are suitable.
literature.break_conditions: Manifolds, unknown multiplicity, badly scaled distances and parameter-sensitive divergence; unshifted deflation can create false small residuals far away.

literature.claim: The good deflated Gauss-Newton method scales an ordinary Gauss-Newton step by a deflation-dependent scalar and, under stated assumptions, cannot converge to deflated points.
literature.assumptions: The residual is smooth, the Jacobian is uniformly full rank near the iterate sequence, steps are well defined and deflated points are isolated.
literature.break_conditions: Rank deficiency, guards or branch changes, constrained projections, positive-residual minima and spurious optimization solutions outside the available theory.

literature.claim: Ill-defined numerical rank can compromise nonlinear least-squares accuracy and makes a fixed rank cutoff unsafe near transitions.
literature.assumptions: Residual and Jacobian errors materially affect the executed step.
literature.break_conditions: A single measured full-rank factorization is not proof of uniform full rank along a trajectory.

literature.claim: Fixed-target anytime runtime distributions compare black-box methods at shared costs and prefixes.
literature.assumptions: Truth, costs, instances and checkpoints are frozen before outcomes are inspected.
literature.break_conditions: Ignoring archive-distance, failed-step, validation or compilation work biases the comparison.

controls.description: Every frozen start uses the unchanged production bounds-scaled LM-QR local attempt; validated configurations enter a passive archive that never changes later steps.
Every eligible post-archive attempt applies the classical shifted power-two residual deflation before the same QR-based local solve, followed by undeformed canonical replay.
differences_from_baseline: Shifted residual deformation around archived configurations

controls.description: Development-only unshifted residual deflation reproduces the documented false-small-residual and divergence risk and can never be promoted.
After the first archived configuration, every eligible start uses the good deflated Gauss-Newton step rule; this mechanism control is reported but cannot replace the ordinary lane.
differences_from_baseline: Good deflated Gauss-Newton on every eligible post-archive attempt

candidates.description: A fixed one-in-four local-attempt lane uses good deflated Gauss-Newton when a nonempty validated configuration archive and measured full-rank route are available; all other attempts use unchanged LM-QR.
differences_from_baseline: Twenty-five percent archive-coupled good deflated Gauss-Newton lane

candidates.description: Every ordinary start is retained, while convergence into a reversible archived configuration niche queues one charged good-deflated-Gauss-Newton retry with an aging fairness rule and no target-based suppression.
differences_from_baseline: Charged archive-coupled good deflated Gauss-Newton rescue

synthetic_families.purpose: Measure whether deflation separates nearby isolated simple roots rather than repeatedly returning the easiest root.
synthetic_families.gold_source: Analytic roots of a univariate product embedded by an invertible generated coordinate warp

synthetic_families.purpose: Ensure configuration-space deflation neither assumes one configuration per target nor merges distinct output identities.
synthetic_families.gold_source: Analytic target map evaluated independently at generated configurations

synthetic_families.purpose: Detect deflation-induced stationary points or small deformed residuals that are not canonical roots.
synthetic_families.gold_source: Analytically inconsistent residual systems with an independent lower bound above zero

synthetic_families.purpose: Verify that singular roots and feasible manifolds route away from the regular deflated lane without silent fallback claims.
synthetic_families.gold_source: Generated analytic rank and manifold parameterization

synthetic_families.purpose: Exercise opaque type-generic calls, stable choices, domains and guards without geometry-name routing.
synthetic_families.gold_source: Independent analytic construction and reference-interpreter replay

synthetic_families.purpose: Bound archive and routing overhead where ordinary LM-QR already reaches the only root reliably.
synthetic_families.gold_source: Analytic affine and mildly curved single-root systems

real_problem_policy: Only independently audited development problems may influence tuning. The already inspected EXP-LOCAL-002 MULTIROOT-WARPED cases are diagnostic-only and cannot set a threshold, select a variant or count toward either formal gate.

execution_order: Freeze the current production LM-QR behavior, the card and a research-only candidate implementation before materializing formal development inputs
Differential-test ordinary steps and canonical replay, then run the unshifted negative control on non-gating counterexamples
Run a mechanism stage with one independently supplied archived root per instance and fixed starts
Run an empty-archive sequential stage in which each variant builds its own archive from canonical validation only
Use at most one declared development round to choose epsilon and ordinary-lane cadence, then freeze one candidate and its applicability predicate
Generate new family-disjoint locked inputs and run fixed attempt, oracle-work and wall-budget gates exactly once
design.pairing: All variants share generated problem, ordered start stream, scale vectors, hard action limits, undeformed canonical validator and Gold metric. Variant-specific archives contain only that variant's accepted endpoints; proposal/start checksums and every archive mutation are persisted.
design.freeze_rule: Power, shift, epsilon, beta singularity rule, trust radius, archive metric, cadence, niche radius and full-rank applicability freeze before any locked input is generated.
design.locked_validation_rule: Inspecting a locked miss burns its whole generator family block; no candidate, threshold or applicability change may be evaluated on that block again.
notes: EVID-19 and NEG-013 are reserved for the eventual formal decision.
The candidate archive is a search structure only; public answers retain the existing non-merging semantics.
Attempt-prefix and oracle-work-prefix results are both mandatory because retry policies do not consume equal work per start.
The ordinary LM-QR lane remains nonvanishing in every promotable candidate.
No observed pre-card diagnostic may enter development or locked artifacts.

deflation_power.rationale: The cited residual and Gauss-Newton studies report power two as an effective multiplicity-robust starting control.
deflation_power.freeze_rule: One development comparison; no case- or root-specific powers.

deflation_shift.rationale: A unit nonzero shift restores the original residual far from archived configurations and avoids the known unshifted failure.
deflation_shift.freeze_rule: Must remain one for every promotable candidate.

good_step_epsilon.rationale: Matches the cited numerical study's small purification neighborhood while leaving an explicit tuning comparison.
good_step_epsilon.freeze_rule: Choose once by development recall, safety and work; never tune on Gold per instance.

beta_singularity_floor.rationale: A near-zero scalar denominator makes the deflated step numerically undefined and must fail closed rather than emit an unbounded step.
beta_singularity_floor.freeze_rule: Choose from finite-step safety only before locked validation.

normalized_trust_radius.rationale: Bounds otherwise arbitrarily enlarged deflated steps while preserving movement across a normalized search box.
normalized_trust_radius.freeze_rule: One development comparison; report separately because projection weakens the paper's theorem assumptions.

ordinary_lane_cadence.rationale: Runs at least three ordinary LM-QR attempts for each deflated attempt in the mixed candidate.
ordinary_lane_cadence.freeze_rule: May change once on development but may never eliminate the ordinary lane.

retry_niche_radius.rationale: Defines only a reversible scheduling niche in bounds-normalized configuration coordinates, not root or target identity.
retry_niche_radius.freeze_rule: Choose once from duplicate-work and recall curves; never use it for output merging.

fixed_starts_per_instance.rationale: Supplies enough sequential archive opportunities to expose close-root duplicate convergence at fixed prefixes.
fixed_starts_per_instance.freeze_rule: Materialize and checksum before any formal variant executes.

budgets.accounting: Charge ordinary and deflated residual/Jacobian calls, rank checks, QR factorizations, archive distance and gradient work, rejected/undefined steps, retry queue work, canonical validation, compilation, cold first use and end-to-end warm wall time.

seeds.generation: Problem, warp, start, metamorphic and mechanism-stage archived-root seeds use separate counter-based namespaces; complete inputs and ordered start checksums freeze before execution.

primary.definition: Fraction of runs recovering every distinct independently audited Gold target with no false accepted target at a fixed attempt, oracle-work or wall prefix.

secondary.definition: Gold configuration recall reported separately from target recall without changing output identity semantics.
Fraction of canonical valid local endpoints falling in an already represented reversible configuration niche.
Primal-equivalent charged work through the first prefix containing all Gold targets.
Archive metric, deflation-gradient and routing wall time divided by fully charged local wall time.
Fraction of proposed deflated actions returning a typed inapplicable or numerically undefined route.

safety.definition: Accepted targets outside independently audited Gold truth after canonical replay.
Deformed or optimizer-success endpoints promoted despite failing the undeformed canonical residual gate.
A deflated step executed after its measured full-rank or semantic applicability check failed.
A finite prefix violates the frozen minimum ordinary LM-QR service cadence.
Work performed beyond a declared callback, iteration, action or wall limit rather than returning a typed stop.

criteria: False-target, positive-residual-promotion, rank-route, ordinary-lane-fairness and budget/deadline violation counts are zero.
At a shared oracle-work or wall budget, P_full_target improves by at least 5 percentage points overall or by at least 15 points in the close-simple-root stratum.
No target-collision, nonzero-minimum, rank/manifold, open-world or regular-overhead stratum loses more than 2 P_full_target points.
At equal P_full_target, oracle work or end-to-end warm wall time improves by at least 20 percent; otherwise regular-family fully charged overhead is at most 10 percent.
The gain repeats in at least three generator-unrelated families and the paired family-clustered one-sided 95 percent interval is on the improvement side.
The locked candidate preserves every ordinary start or proves its frozen nonvanishing ordinary cadence mechanically; no output is merged by configuration distance.
Cold compilation and preparation break even within 64 local attempts on instances selecting the deflated lane.
Any deformed residual, package return code or reversible archive niche bypasses undeformed canonical validation.
Any promotable design eliminates the ordinary LM-QR lane, drops an ordinary start permanently or deflates target values.
Close-root or target-collision P_full_target loses more than 2 points at a shared oracle-work budget.
Rank-deficient, manifold or nonzero-minimum cases enter the deflated route after the frozen applicability checks.
Archive or deflation work exceeds 10 percent on regular unrelated strata without a qualifying recall gain.
After the single tuning round, the best candidate remains within 5 percent of ordinary LM-QR on recall and cost.
The mechanism effect fails to reproduce across separation, dimension, warp and at least three unrelated families.

safety_invariants: Only canonically validated configuration endpoints may become deflation centers, and they remain reversible search hypotheses.
Every accepted endpoint is replayed through the undeformed canonical relation, domain, guard, branch and target semantics.
Target values and Gold truth never influence deflation, routing, archive distance or retry priority.
Capability, rank, branch and domain failure produces a typed unavailable result or the separately scheduled ordinary lane, never a silent stronger claim.
The event loop, CandidateStore, EvidenceLog and final validation pipeline remain singular truth-bearing implementations.
Search exhaustion and failure to find a new root remain unknown rather than a completeness or emptiness claim.
